Terms & ConditionPrivacy Policy

Terms & Conditions

At AbiPlay, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled securely and responsibly. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard the information you provide when using our platform. By using AbiPlay, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

Information We Collect

A. Personal Information

AbiPlay requires all users to register using their Apple account or Google account for seamless access. When you sign up, we may collect:

  • Name: Retrieved automatically from your Apple or Google account.
  • Email Address: Used for account creation, authentication, and communication.
  • Profile Information: Includes optional details like profile pictures and preferences.

B. Non-Personal Information

We collect non-personal data automatically when you use AbiPlay, such as:

  • Device Information: Details about your device (e.g., operating system, browser type).
  • Usage Data: Information about your interactions, including watched content and session duration.
  • Cookies & Tracking: Small files stored on your device to improve user experience and provide personalized recommendations.

How We Use Your Information

A. Personal Information

  • Account Management: Your information helps us manage your account and provide personalized content recommendations.
  • Communication: We may send account updates, notifications, and relevant service-related information.

B. Non-Personal Information

  • Platform Improvement: We analyze usage patterns to enhance the AbiPlay experience, fix bugs, and optimize content delivery.
  • Analytics: Aggregated data helps us understand trends and improve performance.

Advertising & Optional Ad-Free Experience

AbiPlay is ad-supported, allowing users to enjoy movies and shows for free. Users who prefer an ad-free experience may have the option to remove certain in-app ads for a small fee in the future.

Cookies & Tracking Technologies

AbiPlay uses cookies and tracking technologies to:

  • Remember your preferences (e.g., language settings)
  • Enhance personalized recommendations
  • Improve app performance and usability

You can manage or disable cookies through your device settings, but doing so may impact certain features.

Data Sharing & Disclosure

A. Third-Party Service Providers

We work with trusted third-party services (e.g., cloud hosting, analytics platforms) to operate and improve AbiPlay. These providers only access your data as required to perform their functions and must comply with privacy regulations.

B. Legal Compliance

Your personal data may be disclosed if required by law or in response to valid legal requests from authorities.

Data Security

We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no online system is completely secure, and we encourage users to take precautions to protect their information.

Third-Party Links

AbiPlay may include links to external platforms (e.g., YouTube). Our privacy policy applies only to data collected within AbiPlay. We encourage users to review third-party privacy policies before sharing any personal information.

Children's Privacy

AbiPlay is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we discover such data has been collected, we will take immediate steps to delete it.

Your Rights

A. Access & Control of Your Data

Users can access, update, or delete their personal information through their AbiPlay account settings.

B. Opt-Out of Communications

You may opt out of marketing emails by using the unsubscribe option in our messages. However, important service-related notifications will still be sent.

C. Cookie Preferences

Users can adjust cookie settings through their device or browser. Disabling cookies may impact app functionality.

D. Account Deletion

Yes, you can delete your AbiPlay account from the app or our website. Please note:

  • ⚠️ Account deletion is irreversible
  • ⚠️ All saved bookmarks and data will be permanently erased

Data Retention

We retain personal information only as long as necessary for operational, security, and legal purposes. Non-personal analytics data may be stored indefinitely for service improvement.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

AbiPlay reserves the right to update this policy. Changes will be posted here, with the latest update date reflected. Continued use of the platform after updates means acceptance of the new terms.

By using AbiPlay, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy. For questions, contact us at support@abiplay.com
